title: Cafunfo march for public services and Lunda Tchokwe autonomy
participants_original: HRW participant interviews: about 100 marching people. Police account reported by Lusa: about 300.
threshold_50_evidence: Both attributed estimates exceed 50; neither is an exact count.

demands.summary: Autonomy and dialogue demanded of Angola's government.

participants_original.summary: Participant estimate about 100; police claim about 300.

protester_violence.summary: Police alleges armed attack; witnesses deny it. Unresolved.

state_response.beatings.summary: Video described officer kicking and trampling unarmed man.

state_response.killings.summary: HRW attributes at least ten dead protesters to security forces; police six-person total has different scope. No unified casualty count coded.

notes: Government target and threshold documented, but armed rebellion exclusion versus public protest is contested and requires review. Crowds are attributed estimates, not bounds. Shooting alone is not coded crowd dispersal under May 2015 manual. Earlier arrests are contextual, not counted as separate gatherings; physical closure unknown. HRW's attribution concerns protesters; police totals and later deaths/bystander claims are not merged or recoded as protesters. No numeric casualty total field assigned.
open_questions: Resolve protest versus organized armed rebellion from full original investigation and police records.
Determine physical end without converting casualty follow-up into ongoing protest.
Verify tolls and arrest attribution; reports cover different dates.
